data.content_ref: inline:Replace eager materialization of derived artifacts (DefenseWitness, suspend_reason, standing residue) with a demand-driven justification interface: the grounded extension remains a pure function of the argument graph; every derived label is computed only when queried, and each query output is defined purely as a function of the node and the final fixed point, so results are enumeration-order independent by construction rather than by post-hoc tie-breaking. This directly answers SRC_008's determinism critique of SRC_003/SRC_004 without adding any stored state. Criticizable: adversarial query sequences may defeat memoization and break the polynomial-cost bound; caching reintroduces order dependence unless cache invalidation is itself fixed-point-relative; and 'pure function of the fixed point' is hard to make checkable for arbitrary derived predicates.
